steps.en: Declare the shared state and write each step as a plain function node
steps.zh: 声明共享状态，把每一步写成普通函数节点

steps.en: Wire the steps with edges; a conditional edge lets the model pick the next node
steps.zh: 用边把步骤连起来；条件边让模型选下一个节点

steps.en: Compile with a checkpointer and run under a thread id
steps.zh: 挂上检查点存储编译，用一个线程 ID 运行

steps.en: Runs nodes along the edges, merging each node's update into the state
steps.zh: 沿着边执行节点，把每个节点的更新合并进状态

steps.en: Saves a checkpoint after every super-step under that thread id
steps.zh: 每个超步结束，按线程 ID 存一个检查点

steps.en: On interrupt() or a crash it stops; re-invoking the thread resumes from the last checkpoint
steps.zh: 遇到 interrupt() 或崩溃就停；再次调用同一线程从最后检查点接着跑

value.en: Long-running agents can pause for humans and survive restarts without you building a state store
value.zh: 长时间运行的智能体能停下来等人、扛过重启，不用自己造状态存储
